recognize_zh: 一顆漿細胞核偏心、細胞質呈深藍色，胞質內擠滿許多圓形淡染小空泡狀包涵體（Russell bodies），呈葡萄串樣，這就是 Mott 細胞；影像解析度有限，包涵體呈淡灰藍而非明顯粉紅。
features: Single plasma cell with eccentric nucleus and clumped chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm packed with numerous small, round, pale/clear globular inclusions (Russell bodies) in a grape-like pattern
Inclusions displace but do not obscure the nucleus
Background of well-spread red cells and small platelet clumps; no other nucleated cells in field
Low image resolution limits assessment of inclusion color and chromatin detail
describe_en: Smear shows a thinly spread area with well-separated red cells and scattered platelet clumps. A single plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus and coarse chromatin has deeply basophilic cytoplasm filled with numerous small, round, pale globular inclusions consistent with Russell bodies, characteristic of a Mott cell. The image resolution is limited, and the surrounding marrow cellularity and plasma cell percentage cannot be assessed from this single field. Mott cells represent accumulation of retained immunoglobulin and are nonspecific, occurring in reactive plasmacytosis as well as in MGUS and plasma cell neoplasms.

ddx.vs: Flame cells have a diffuse magenta peripheral cytoplasmic hue with frayed edges rather than discrete round globular inclusions.
Dutcher bodies are intranuclear (cytoplasmic pseudoinclusions overlying the nucleus), whereas Russell bodies lie within the cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Vacuolated blasts or lymphoma cells (e.g., Burkitt)
ddx.vs: Burkitt cells have sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles with immature chromatin and no plasma cell features such as an eccentric nucleus with clock-face chromatin.
Artifactual or degenerative vacuoles are irregular and empty, whereas Russell bodies are uniform round globules that are PAS-positive and immunoglobulin-positive.
